originalDsl:
@diagram uml-sequence
User actor as "User"
ClientApp participant as "Client App"
AuthServer participant as "Authorization Server"
IdentityProvider participant as "Identity Provider"
ConsentService participant as "Consent Service"
TokenStore participant as "Token Store"
ResourceServer participant as "Resource Server"

msg_1 = User -#> ClientApp as "click login"
msg_2 = ClientApp -#> AuthServer as "authorization request"
msg_3 = AuthServer -#> IdentityProvider as "redirect for authentication"
msg_4 = User -#> IdentityProvider as "submit credentials"
msg_5 = IdentityProvider -.-> AuthServer as "identity confirmed"
msg_6 = AuthServer -#> ConsentService as "request user consent"
msg_7 = User -#> ConsentService as "approve scopes"
msg_8 = ConsentService -.-> AuthServer as "consent granted"
msg_9 = AuthServer -#> TokenStore as "store authorization code"
msg_10 = AuthServer -.-> ClientApp as "authorization code"
msg_11 = ClientApp -#> AuthServer as "exchange code for token"
msg_12 = AuthServer -#> TokenStore as "validate code"
msg_13 = TokenStore -.-> AuthServer as "code valid"
msg_14 = AuthServer -.-> ClientApp as "access token"
msg_15 = ClientApp -#> ResourceServer as "request resource with token"
msg_16 = ResourceServer -#> AuthServer as "validate token"
msg_17 = AuthServer -.-> ResourceServer as "token valid"
msg_18 = ResourceServer -.-> ClientApp as "protected resource"
